auditScope: Audio/Video Understanding via locked DSH & Host Runtime
summary: Locked DSH packages (@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment 0.1.1-rc.2, @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm 0.1.1-rc.2, @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai 0.1.1-rc.2) and underlying @earendil-works/pi-ai 0.82.1 provide NO native audio/video input block types, NO audio/video attachment storage, and NO audio/video wire serialization. Host metadata (capabilities.cjs) exposes tasks but has no active adapter endpoint mappings for audio/video understanding. Any audio/video blocks passed to the adapter are either rejected by admission gates or silently dropped by userContent(), resulting in 0 wire bytes sent.

packagesAudited.role: Local storage implementation & image limit enforcer

nativeMessageBlockRepresentation.finding: ContentBlockMap only defines 'text' | 'reasoning' | 'image' | 'tool-call' | 'tool-result'. No AudioBlock or VideoBlock types exist in DSH LLM.

attachmentLayerRepresentation.finding: AttachmentStore strictly checks mediaTypes ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp', 'image/gif']. Audio and video MIME types throw AttachmentError with code UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE_TYPE.

adapterWireFields.finding: pi-ai openai-completions serializer only generates type: 'image_url'. No input_audio or video fields exist. In dsh-llm-pi-ai userContent(), unrecognized blocks hit default: break and are omitted.

transcodingAndFrameExtraction.hostWiring: Pre-processing pipeline required (ASR for audio, ffmpeg keyframe extraction for video)
transcodingAndFrameExtraction.finding: To support AV understanding with current locked DSH, host must preprocess audio via Speech-to-Text (ASR) into text blocks, and preprocess video via keyframe extraction into native image blocks.

timestampProvenanceAndPrecision.sourceLocation: N/A (No temporal grounding structures in DSH or pi-ai)
timestampProvenanceAndPrecision.finding: No native timestamping, subtitle alignment, or chunked audio offset markers exist in the model message protocol.

uploadAndStreamLimits.hostWiring: Image limits only: 4 images, 10MB decoded limit
uploadAndStreamLimits.finding: MAX_IMAGES=4, MAX_BYTES=10MB enforced for images. No streaming audio or large video chunking infrastructure exists in host runtime.

coldHistoryReplayAndSourceSha.finding: DSH attachment service does not persist or reference audio/video objects. Session replay cannot reconstruct AV media blocks without external object store.

sameKeyEligibility.finding: capabilities.cjs PT_TASK_ADAPTER_ENDPOINTS has no entry for audioUnderstanding or videoUnderstanding. States are permanently endpointCompatible: false and autoEligible: false.
